# Wire and winding test coupons (generated by rf2/variant_plugins/coil_winding.py; MODELED expectations)

Status: MODELED. No coupon has been made or measured. Expected values come from the Rubadue catalog (data/datasheets/Rubadue_insulated_litz_FEP_ETFE_TCA.pdf, DATASHEET_LOG RF2-DS-WIRE: circular mils, strands, finished OD, section voltage rating) through rf2/rf2_wire_options.py, and from the plugin's geometry model. Pass limits marked ASSUMED are proposals for the owner, not vendor tolerances (the catalog says 'request specification sheet' for breakdown).

Rule 6 (coil flyback nets: 630 V parts) is applied to the CATALOG rating. A 600 V construction that passes the coupon hipot stays BLOCKED until the owner decides; the coupon only gives the owner the measured margin.

## 1. Litz coupons (one set per construction)

Per construction: (a) a 1.000 m straight length, both ends stripped 10 mm, strands tinned in a solder pot (FEP does not strip in solder: strip mechanically first), 4-wire Kelvin clips 900 mm apart for DC R; (b) a 2-turn loop on a printed ring at r 110 mm (stacked at the comb row pitch) for L / AC R / Q; (c) two 0.5 m pieces twisted together (twisted-pair, 12 twists per 100 mm, ASSUMED after the magnet-wire twisted-pair method) for turn-to-turn breakdown; (d) a 0.5 m piece wound 3 turns on a mandrel of 5 x OD (ASSUMED lead-exit bend) then hipot again.

Measurements and limits:
- DC R at 20 C (correct with alpha 0.00393 / K): expected rho20 x 1.02 lay / catalog area; pass within +-5 % (ASSUMED: strand diameter tolerance).
- Hipot conductor to a foil wrap / water bath: 2 x 630 V = 1260 V DC for 60 s (the rule-6 basis), leakage <= 1 mA (ASSUMED); then raised in 100 V steps to 2 x catalog rating, record the first failure.
- Turn-to-turn on the twisted pair: ramp 500 V/s to breakdown, 5 samples; pass if the lowest is >= 2 x the worst modelled turn-to-turn voltage of the chosen winding AND >= 920 V (2 x the 460 V flyback, both walls in series) (ASSUMED limits).
- AC R and Q on the 2-turn loop at 10, 50, 100 kHz (LCR meter, series mode): expected R_ac / R_dc from the strand skin factor 1 + (r/delta)^4/48 (below); the bundle proximity effect is NOT modelled, so pass if R_ac(100 kHz) / R_dc <= 1.20 (ASSUMED) and record it.
- OD with a micrometer at 10 points: within catalog nominal +-0.05 mm (ASSUMED), and <= comb slot - 0.05 mm to seat (slot 1.47 mm today; 1.60 mm in the wide-slot comb option).
- Bend: after (d), no insulation crack under 10x loupe and the hipot passes again.

## 2. Winding coupons (capacitance and turn-to-turn map)

(a) **Pair-capacitance comb section** (validates the model input C_ij): a straight 300 mm printed comb section (6 combs, 0.8 mm plates at today's 57.6 mm spacing), 30 straight 340 mm pieces of the litz laid in the 5 x 6 slots, ends free. Measure at 10 kHz (LCR, guarded) the capacitance of each neighbour pair (vertical, radial, diagonal) with all other pieces grounded, each outer-column piece to a grounded copper foil at the shield-coat position (1.05 mm outside the outer column centre), and each bottom-row piece to a grounded plate at z 3.2. Test it dry and again potted in the channel epoxy (the model uses eps_r 2.1, FEP only: the potted ratio gives the real eps_eff). Expected (eps 2.1, 0.300 m): vertical 21.5 pF, radial 16.0 pF, diagonal x 0.5 6.3 pF, to shield foil 27.0 pF, to the z 3.2 plate 22.9 pF (today's litz). Pass: each within +-30 % of the model dry (ASSUMED); the potted / dry ratio is recorded and fed back as eps_eff.

(b) **Ring coupons, one per winding pattern** (validates the voltage-map energy method): a printed full ring with today's comb cross-section (5 columns x 6 rows, outer column at r 50 mm) wound with 26 turns of today's litz in each pattern (8.5 m of litz per coupon), with and without ground: a grounded copper-foil band 1.05 mm outside the outer column centre (the shield coat) plus a grounded plate 1.29 mm below the bottom-row centre (the z 3.2 plane). Measure L at 10 kHz and the first self-resonance f_SRF with an impedance analyser; C_self = 1 / ((2 pi f_SRF)^2 L) less the fixture C (measure the open fixture). Hipot between the coil ends and the foil at 1260 V DC. Pass: C_self within +-30 % of the model (ASSUMED) and the RANKING of the patterns as modelled.

## Assumptions and limits

- Linear voltage along the winding at the 460 V clamp (low-frequency energy method); distributed / transmission-line effects, litz strand-to-strand capacitance and the potting epoxy's permittivity are not modelled (eps_r 2.1 everywhere: the real C is higher, roughly in proportion to eps_eff).
- Diagonal neighbours count x 0.5 (screening, as rf2_taper); ground: the shield coat (r 114.45, joined to SH1) and a plane at z 3.2 (rf2_taper ASSUMPTION).
- Row pitch = OD + today's 0.068 mm stacking allowance; the bottom wire sits on the floor; the outer column stays at r 113.4.
- Parallel strands share current equally and sit at the same potential (rf2_lowL_options ASSUMPTION).
- Resistances at 20 C as rf2_wire_options (lay factor 1.02 ASSUMED); masses from its catalog-derived g/m (enamel / bunching factor ASSUMED).
- The rf2_head spec text says the coil is wound 'column by column down-and-up' (~195 V), while the slot order in rf2_lowL_options / the rf2_head builder is row by row; the variant engine's today is the row order. The 'colzz' option is the documented order.
